article.title: MoEngage整合個人AI決策，Merlin代理連接行銷資料
article.title_en: MoEngage integrates individual AI decisioning with Merlin workflows
article.summary: MoEngage在NEXT Autumn’26公布Merlin代理工具及已整合的Aampe AI Decisioning，連接個人偏好與活動執行。
article.summary_en: MoEngage announced Merlin capabilities and integrated Aampe AI Decisioning at NEXT Autumn’26.
highlights: Merlin Agent Harness加入Context Hub、創意生成及雙向連接器。
Merlin Agent可跨資料倉庫、CRM及分析工具找出指標變化並提出活動建議。
highlights_en: Merlin Agent Harness adds a Context Hub, creative generation and two-way connectors.
Merlin Agent spans warehouses, CRM and analytics to identify metric changes and propose campaigns.
article.why: 個人偏好決策與活動提案接在同一平台，客戶經營團隊可決定哪些優惠、渠道及發送時機交予模型選擇。
article.why_en: Lifecycle teams can decide which offer, channel and timing choices to delegate to individual-level decisioning.
article.next_step: 用一項重複購買提醒列出可變的優惠、內容、渠道和時機，向供應商確認可設定的審閱點及適用帳戶。
article.next_step_en: For one repeat-purchase reminder, list variable offers, content, channels and timing, then confirm review points and account access.
article.detail: 公告把AI Decisioning描述為已整合到MoEngage，並由行銷人員設定品牌規則及審閱位置。個人化決策是按每位客戶的偏好調整選項，與單純按群組發送有所不同。團隊可先限定一項訊息目標，再檢查代理如何把指標變動連接至提案，逐步決定要採用的決策範圍與人工審閱方式。
article.detail_en: MoEngage describes decisioning as integrated, with marketers setting brand guardrails and review points. Individual preferences differ from a group-only send. Limit the initial message objective and inspect how an observed metric change becomes a proposal before selecting the scope of automated decisions.
